items.title: Aon (AON) Taps Darren Van’t Hof For Tax Credit Financing
items.summary: Aon (NYSE:AON) appointed Darren Van’t Hof as Head of Tax Credit Financing, Transaction Solutions. Van’t Hof is an industry-recognized leader in renewable energy finance and former interim President and CEO at the Solar Energy Industries Association. The role focuses on tax credit financing, including tax equity investments and transfer of renewable energy tax credits.
